answers.core: This is about improving the experience for power users running lots of projects cloned from GitHub, or minimal reproduction projects.
answers.workaround:
Yes, by running the following command:

```bash
godot --path /path/to/project --import && godot --path /path/to/project
```

However, you have to remember to do this the first time you open a project that has missing resources. Also, if you run the above command when resources were already imported, it'll just waste time running and exiting the editor for 10+ seconds (with a debug build).

title: Automatically import resources and restart the project if attempting to run a project with missing resources
